items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Harley is addressed by the interviewer as a second party in the conversation ('...now as they used to, Harley. Do they?'), but the interviewee does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Harley.

ctx.x: I'm sure you will. They don't start as young, though, now as they used to, Harley. Do they?
Well, this kid started since he was two years old.
